storage: Airtight jar, away from light and heat; keep dry in the monsoon.
looksLike: A fine, pale greenish-khaki powder with a sweet, anise-like smell, made by grinding dried fennel seed.
howToPick: Look for a fresh green-beige colour and a strong sweet smell; a dull colour or weak smell means old stock. For best flavour, dry-roast whole seed lightly and grind it at home.
shelfLife: Ground powder keeps its aroma for about 6 months in a sealed pack; whole seed lasts about 1 year.
substitutes: Whole fennel seeds, ground at home

usedIn.raw: 2 g fennel powder per serving (1 tsp)
